purpose: Defines requirements for how forge query-db and update-db wrappers automatically select between the doc-link and doc-db search backends, handle fallback, unprepared indexes, freshness, and failures.
summary: Automatic backend selection driven by an ordered list, with availability judgment owned by each backend
Query wrapper behavior: no index preparation of its own, approval-gated index building via update wrapper, nonexistent paths filtered out
Update wrapper behavior: DLID writing to documents, doc-link index sync, backend specification without fallback
Notification requirements for execution path, fallback reasons, DLID writes, freshness, and failures
Business rules BL-001 to BL-007: default order, freshness, success vs failure, unprepared vs fault, series scoping, backend designation, index population ownership
Non-functional requirements: observability, backward compatibility, responsiveness, availability, information protection
Error case table mapping conditions to actions
Scope, prerequisites, glossary, and flow diagram for backend selection
tasks: Implementing or modifying query-db-rules and query-db-specs wrappers
Implementing or modifying update-db-rules and update-db-specs wrappers
Designing doc-link and doc-db backend selection and fallback logic
Handling unprepared index approval and index rebuilding flows
Reviewing error handling and failure classification of document search
Writing tests for backend selection behavior
title: REQ-014 doc-db バックエンド選択 要件定義書
